correctness.rationale: For each nonempty vertex set T in Q4, the binary incidence code row sum [I16|B] is (1_T,1_{delta(T)}), so its Hamming weight is |T|+|delta(T)|=5|T|−2e(T). Support-minimality is equivalent to connected induced Q4[T]: if disconnected, a component codeword has support contained; if connected, each proper nonempty submask has an internal crossing edge absent from delta(T), preventing support containment. Independently checked all 65535 nonzero masks by connectivity, internal edges and exact weight, yielding the complete 22-term spectrum claimed; its coefficient sum is 37293 and minimum distance is five. The finite enumeration is exhaustive for exactly this 16-vertex graph, not a claim for Qd generally.
